sample_unit: responses (3 queries x 20 repetitions x 3 sources)

links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT versus Google responses to hand surgery patient questions
links.effect: Google averaged an eighth-grade reading level for moderate-high consensus topics versus college sophomore level for ChatGPT (P<.0001); low consensus topics had poor readability throughout; ChatGPT-4 was less readable than ChatGPT-3.5 for low consensus topics (P<.01).
links.quote: Compared to Google, ChatGPT does not provide readable responses when providing reliable medical information.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability, reliability, and accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 and 4.0 responses for patient-facing hand surgery questions without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
